label: Makinson boundary in the shared-plus-local profile
description: Under ERROR_DEPENDENCE_1 an assertion and the some-failure event have probabilities x and 1-x, which a threshold above one half cannot both reach. With local probability r<1, κ(G)·r^n ≤ r^n eventually falls below 1-t. Threshold acceptance is PRO_TANTO_SUPPORT_THRESHOLD_FULL_BELIEF_1, an analyst policy, not warrant.
